en: Download and install Prism directly: Windows x64 installer, plus native Mac DMGs for Apple silicon and Intel. Git and Node.js are no longer required to install the app; official model CLIs and subscription login remain separate.

Installer editions keep settings, tasks and drafts in the user data directory. Updates download only on request and verify the published SHA-256 digest. Windows installs after confirmation; Mac opens the DMG for manual replacement.

Mac CLI discovery includes common Homebrew and user paths. Execution uses an isolated Unix process group, with confirmed cancellation of its descendants. Installers are not signed with a commercial developer certificate; Mac builds are ad-hoc signed and are not notarized.
zh: 提供 Windows x64 安装包，以及 Apple 芯片与 Intel 的 Mac 原生 DMG。安装棱镜无需 Git 或 Node.js；各模型官方 CLI 与订阅账号仍需单独安装、登录。
安装版将设置、任务与草稿保存在用户数据目录。更新只在确认后下载，并核对发布的 SHA-256。Windows 确认后安装；Mac 打开 DMG 后手动替换应用。
Mac 自动发现常见 Homebrew 与用户目录中的 CLI；执行使用独立 Unix 进程组，停止时核对本次执行及其子进程退出。安装包暂无商业开发者证书签名；Mac 使用临时签名，尚未公证。
